info.name: Parade Transactions Available Trucks Carrier Onboarding Status API
Get the onboarding status of a carrier

params.name: dot_number
params.description: DOT number of the carrier being looked up

params.name: company_external_key
params.description: External key of the broker that this carrier belongs to

items.docs: Given the DOT number and the broker external key, we can share the current onboarding status for that carrier.
